scientific_limitations: The Veronese order is restricted to 1 <= k < min_i d_i, before complete-intersection equations create degree-k relations.
Odd degree forces at least one real ramification point but does not imply simple ramification or count distinct real points.
An unindexed classical source could contain the same parity corollary explicitly.
title: Binary parity law for Veronese ramification of complete-intersection curves
